subject: App times out "Disconnected from the server" while loading data

messages.author: 4b0718d03ea48191
messages.subject: App times out "Disconnected from the server" while loading data
parts:
Hi,

I have two apps, one is working and the other is not:

working:
https://reesenewslab.shinyapps.io/turnout/

not working:
https://reesenewslab.shinyapps.io/history/

Both apps load a dataframe in R binary format and display a subset of rows meeting criteria.

For the app that's not working, I get an error message after the GUI is displayed but before the data loads
"Disconnected from the server"

The console error is:
"Connection closed. Info: {"type":"close","code":4702,"reason":"Error reading from Shiny","wasClean":true}"

The strange thing is that I created the second app from the first app, and the second app loads a smaller dataframe.  I've already changed the Startup Timeout to the max of 300 seconds.

Does anyone have any ideas for fixing this?

Thanks

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: App times out "Disconnected from the server" while loading data
parts: The application is exceeding the available memory and is being killed. You could try with a larger instance type.
